title: 23andMe company valuation: 2021 public listing vs. 2025 bankruptcy sale (million dollars)

source.name: 23andMe SPAC listing valuation and bankruptcy asset sale reporting
source.publisher: SEC filings / financial press (Reuters, Yahoo Finance)

notes: 23andMe went public via SPAC merger in 2021 at a roughly $3.5 billion valuation. It filed for bankruptcy in March 2025 and its assets sold to Regeneron Pharmaceuticals for $256 million in a bankruptcy auction.
